sections.faq:
Is the StickyCTA plugin compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes, the StickyCTA plugin is fully compatible with a wide range of WordPress themes, ensuring seamless integration and an enhanced user experience across various design styles.

Can I display the banner only on specific devices, such as mobiles or tablets?

Certainly! StickyCTA offers extensive customization options, allowing you to control the banner’s visibility on specific devices, including mobiles, tablets, desktops, or any combination that suits your targeting strategy.

How can I access the performance statistics of my banners to evaluate their effectiveness?

To assess the impact of your banners, the StickyCTA dashboard provides real-time performance statistics, including clicks, conversions, and user engagement. This data empowers you to make data-driven decisions and optimize your call-to-action strategy.

How can I duplicate an existing banner to create a new one with the same design?

Duplicating banners is a breeze with StickyCTA. On the banner management page, simply utilize the “Duplicate” feature next to your desired banner. By doing so, you can effortlessly create new banners with consistent design elements, saving valuable time and effort.

Does StickyCTA offer a multilingual version to reach a broader audience?

Absolutely! With multilingual support, StickyCTA enables you to engage audiences from various regions by customizing your banners with content in different languages. Expand your reach and make your calls-to-action universally appealing with ease.

1.3.1 ( 2024-09-24 )

  • New plugin slug

1.3.0 ( 2024-09-03 )

  • Remove license check for wordpress.org
  • Updated the Trix library to version 2.0.8
  • Confirms support for WordPress 6.6.1
  • Optimization and rewrite of certain functions and features

1.2.0 ( 2024-07-23 )

  • Confirms support for WordPress 6.6
  • Removed the jQuery library from the plugin files
  • Updated the AlpineJS library to version 3.14.1
  • Updated the Pickr library to version 1.9.1
  • Updated the Trix library to version 1.3.2
  • Added uncompressed libraries for AlpineJS, Trix, and Pickr
  • Fixed an error preventing the reset of banner statistics on a specific page
  • Optimization and rewrite of certain functions and features
  • Improved data validation processes and data display to enhance the plugin’s security
  • Completely rewrote the code managing banner display

1.1.0 ( 2024-07-08 )

  • Complete code review of the plugin in preparation for its release on wordpress.org
  • Optimization and rewrite of certain functions and features
  • Added the use of ‘nonce’ to prevent unauthorized actions and ensure reliable statistics
  • Fixed database queries to improve the plugin’s security
  • Removed the automatic update system (to be handled by wordpress.org)
  • Updated readme.txt and the information available in the plugin details

1.0.4 ( 2024-06-04 )

  • Integrated an automatic update system from the WordPress dashboard
  • Fixed display issue of the statistics table on Firefox

1.0.3.6.2 ( 2024-01-08 )

  • General PHP fixes

1.0.3.6.1 ( 2023-12-22 )

  • Optimizing the readme.txt file

1.0.3.6 ( 2023-12-14 )

  • General PHP fixes
  • Revision of license verification system

1.0.3.5 ( 2023-11-28 )

  • General PHP fixes

1.0.3.4 ( 2023-11-23 )

  • Enhanced Top Banner Display
  • Three Banner Size Options

1.0.3.3 ( 2023-11-14 )

  • General PHP fixes

1.0.3.2 ( 2023-10-25 )

  • General PHP fixes
  • General JS fixes

1.0.3.1 ( 2023-10-17 )

  • Added hover functionality to display full titles in banner statistics for each page or article
  • Included banner identifiers in statistics views to specify which banner’s data is being displayed
  • Implemented a “Reset Stats” button for zeroing out all banner statistics in both detailed page/article view and in the “Campaigns” section
  • Introduced a delete icon in “Statistics” for direct banner deletion
  • Added a “Delete” button in banner edit mode with a confirmation prompt
  • Introduced the “Title Font Weight” option for main titles

1.0.3 ( 2023-10-12 )

  • Implemented tooltips on all icons
  • Added feature to delete a banner from a campaign through the campaign statistics
  • Obfuscated outgoing links from the popup by default
  • Added support for mobile-specific close icon color
  • Replaced banner title with custom name in “Statistics” page
  • Replaced banner title with custom name in page statistics
  • Replaced banner title with custom name in campaign options
  • Remove license from main server upon plugin deactivation
  • Enabled statistics dashboard access in the free version
  • Introduced feature to display banners related to taxonomy (tags & categories)
  • Redirect users to the same page to prevent rapid action repetition in statistics, dashboard, and elsewhere
  • Restructured close icon on mobile to prevent overlap with text
  • Enabled page viewing from the “Statistics” tab on which a banner has been displayed (real-time statistics viewable)
  • Tracked the CTR of popup openings relative to banner openings, and likewise for popup closures relative to popup openings, in statistics
  • Display only existing banners in page-level statistics
  • Restricted banner creation to 1 instead of 2 for the free version
  • Limited option selection for pages and articles in the free version: only allow selection of “All pages” and “All posts”
  • Enabled “All pages” and “All posts” to be checked by default during banner creation
  • Changed display system to show only a single banner when not part of a campaign

1.0.2 ( 2023-10-01 )

  • Integrated WooCommerce compatibility for banner rendering
  • Resolved text escaping issues causing backslashes with apostrophes in text fields
  • Added conditional logic to hide related fields when disabling icons
  • Fixed obfuscated link behavior, ensuring correct new tab opening
  • Implemented multi-line banner title support
  • Addressed micro-flashing of banner popups during resource overload
  • Aligned input type number increment arrows with pixel unit display
  • Resolved dynamic hover state bugs in button previews
  • Corrected dynamic color picker binding malfunctions
  • Expanded search engine to display more than 5 articles
  • One-click banner deactivation from dashboard
  • ID-based page and article exclusion functionality
  • Role-based statistics exclusion
  • Customizable border thickness on a per-side basis
  • Text size and weight adjustments for buttons
  • WYSIWYG HTML editor integrated for popup content
  • Added icon positioning and color configuration within buttons
  • Configurable behavior and styling for popup close button
  • Redirect behavior post-popup interaction
  • Live preview during banner creation/editing
  • Mobile-responsive design improvements for close button
  • Default banner title center-alignment
  • Campaign management features, including creation, editing, and deletion
  • Dynamic banner serving based on open rate for A/B Testing
  • HTML markup support in banner titles
  • Fixed banner overflow issues on WordPress navbar
  • Enhanced color picker UX
  • Custom campaign naming functionality
  • Default transparent background for icons
  • Input type number for pixel value entries
  • Adjusted button and title position on desktop
  • Updated reset statistics icon
  • Form sections differentiated by color coding

1.0.1 (2023-08-12)

  • Implemented redirect to edit page post-banner creation
  • Enhanced statistical analytics on the statistics page
  • Expanded banner creation/editing options with new customization features
  • Real-time banner preview functionality added
  • Minor bug fixes including form UI improvements and dynamic color picker binding

1.0.0 ( 2023-07-22 )

  • First public release
